sealed_statement.construction: Q_sigma has S_sigma with exact G[S_sigma] edges, one vertex [C] per residual Y0 component, no [C]-[D] edges, and v-[C] iff v is complete to C.
conclusion: For every k>=1, each induced P_k in Q_sigma lifts to an induced P_k in G by arbitrary component representatives.
Hence ambient P7-freeness of G implies Q_sigma is P7-free.

proof_core: survivor-component relation is exact by B0 complete/anticomplete uniformity
firewalls: P7-free quotient does not imply bounded width.
Probe-completion existence does not imply colouring tractability.
